question.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $Y$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[1, 16\right],$ compute $P\left(Y  \geq  10\right).$
question.worked_solution:
The probability density function for a uniformly distributed continuous random variable $Y$ on an interval $[a,b]$ is given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14270027/assets/64661e76a430c63a3ba74d43f3d074e43d5c03a1a09c39d714a087d5fb8b5afa.svg)

Our random variable $Y$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[1, 16\right],$ so it has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14270027/assets/bd2bfc727ccdaeb4d0912640c12fa99900db52102aefe3a3dce46ad2e2cbfef0.svg)

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Y\ge 10) & =P(10\le Y\le 16) \\  & ={\int }_{10}^{16}f(y)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{10}^{16}\frac{1}{15}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{16-10}{15} \\  & =\frac{6}{15} \\  & =\frac{2}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
